caption: The drawing depicts a single brown bottle placed upright at the center of the composition. The bottle has a narrow neck that flares slightly at the top and widens into a round body. The upper section of the bottle features diagonal, swirling grooves that wrap around its surface. The middle portion of the bottle is decorated with a band of geometric patterns consisting of triangles and circular motifs, with the circles enclosed by sunburst-like lines set within diamond shapes arranged in a horizontal row. The lower section of the bottle displays vertical ridges. The background is a plain, light beige color, and the bottle is framed within a thin, hand-drawn rectangular border. In the lower right corner outside the border, there is a handwritten note with a name and a date: "John Dana 5/12/31."
title: Decanter
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
